title: mirabilis cordifolia
intro: Mirabilis cordifolia, commonly known as Heart-Leaf Four O'Clock, is a plant species in the Four O'Clock family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, inflammation, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Mirabilis cordifolia are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a useful remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Mirabilis cordifolia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
